name: AL RIGGA GYM & STUDIO
address: Al Rigga Gym , VIVA Supermarket building ,M Floor - Al Maktoum Rd - Al Rigga - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: AL RIGGA GYM & STUDIO is one of the best gyms in Deira, offering a complete fitness experience for all fitness levels. We provide personal training, kickboxing, karate, Zumba, yoga, CrossFit, and a variety of group classes. With professional trainers, modern equipment, and a motivating environment, we support strength building, endurance training, weight management, and overall wellbeing through structured and result focused workout programs.

reviews.author: maria bayan
reviews.text:
Love this gym! It’s not crowded especially since I usually train early in the morning. Rahul is a great trainer and always helpful.

My only concern is the new trainer I think a better approach when interacting with members would be helpful. As a new trainer, it would be nice to first introduce herself and get to know members before stepping into their usual routines. I appreciate her being proactive but familiarizing with customers first would be helpful. Overall, its good gym but will be last session as the approach from someone who Im unfamiliar with puts me off.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you for your honest feedback. We truly appreciate your suggestions and will take them into consideration as we continue improving our members' experience. We're sorry to hear you're leaving and wish you all the best on your fitness journey.

reviews.author: Imaan Abdul Samad
reviews.text:
I’ve been training here for just a month, and the experience has been absolutely fantastic. The gym itself is great, but the absolute highlight has been training with Firoz.
Thanks to his guidance, support, and structured workouts, I have already lost 5 kg in just one month! If you’re looking for a gym that actually helps you reach your goals, and a trainer who keeps you motivated every step of the way, I highly recommend training with Firoz here.
reviews.owner_reply: Thank you so much for your wonderful review! We're delighted to hear you've had such a positive experience and are already seeing great results. Your feedback means a lot to us and motivates our team to keep delivering the best support and training experience. We look forward to helping you achieve even more of your fitness goals. Keep up the amazing work!

reviews.author: Afsal Afsal

Your appreciation for Trainer Haris means a lot to us. Thank you for recommendation, and we look forward to supporting your continued fitness journey.

reviews.author: Ziad Lel
reviews.text:
I have had the membership with this gym for the past 2 months, and I definitely will renew again for the following reasons:

1- The gym is really clean.

2- Nicely decorated.

3- The employees are friendly and will help you anytime you need.

4- They gym is open 24 hours except for sundays (from 4 p.m. until 12 a.m.)

5- The location of the gym is good, and they have a panoramic view on the highway.

So, if you are located in Al Rigga, I recommend this gym because the time is flexible, and you can go to do you your workout anytime you feel free.

reviews.author: Jhosanel Vergara
reviews.text:
As someone completely new to the gym, I was honestly nervous at first—but Haris and Salman made it so easy to get started. They're super supportive, explain everything clearly, and really care about helping you improve.

All the Staffs in Al Rigga Gym were very welcoming, friendly and professional. A special thanks to Salman and Haris for always guiding me to my fitness journey - they're really a great help. With their guidance I've seen noticeable improvements with my strength, endurance and overall fitness.

Highly recommend for anyone starting their strength journey! 🔥🙌
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you so much for your thoughtful feedback! We’re truly glad to hear that your journey with us has been positive from the very beginning. Our team is committed to creating a supportive and comfortable environment for everyone, especially those new to the gym.
We’re happy to know that our guidance has helped you improve your strength, endurance, and overall fitness. Keep up the amazing progress we’re here to support you every step of the way!

reviews.author: Muhammad
reviews.text:
I had a very negative experience with the summer camp at Al rigga Gym. An one older lady teacher repeatedly scolded and ridiculed my child in front of other kids. This is completely unacceptable. The management must take action against this behavior. All the other coaches are doing a great job, and the teacher in question should be told to at least try to match their professionalism.
It's concerning that the manager or administrator is not showing the basic competence to handle such a situation. Because of this terrible experience, I will not be sending my child to any of their future programs, nor will I recommend Al rigga Gym to anyone."

reviews.author: Satpal Choudhary
reviews.text:
I am joined the Al rigga gym and have had a great experience so far. The facility is clean and well-maintained, with a wide range of equipment suitable for all types of workouts, from cardio to strength training.

The staff is friendly and always available to help or provide guidance. The personal trainers are knowledgeable and motivating, making it easy to stick to my fitness goals.

What I appreciate most is the variety of classes offered, including cardio classes,  which are well-organized and cater to different fitness levels.

reviews.text: Askar has been an amazing trainer for my weight loss journey! With his guidance, I was able to lose around 13 kg in 10 months. His expertise, motivation, and support made a huge difference. I highly recommend Askar to anyone looking to achieve their weight loss goals at Al Rigga Gym.
